items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: They'd say, 'Mr. Jones, who was your teacher?' ... I would move up the line into Teddy Wilson ... 'All these guys are my teachers, you know?'

ctx.x: Yeah. And you know the way that thing worked, it was quite strange in that Teddy Wilson, as far as pianos are concerned, there's no way to -- in a sextet and a trio -- there's no way that Benny could tell a story without Teddy Wilson being in it, you know?
